data.one_liner: A Flutter widget to display customizable text avatars with optional tap-to-select behavior.
data.what_it_does: It renders a circular or rectangular avatar showing the first character of a string. The avatar can animate to a check icon on tap and provides a ListTile wrapper for selectable list items.
use_when: You need simple text‑based user avatars
You want a tappable avatar that toggles selection state
You need a lightweight widget without external image dependencies
avoid_when: You require image‑based avatars or network pictures
You need multi‑character or rich‑text avatars
You need advanced animation or theming beyond the provided options
strengths: Customizable size, shape, colors, and border radius
